{{Top|canon=Geonosian hive-mind}}
'''Geonosian''' was the language of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. It consisted of click consonants, possible through the dual mandibles of Geonosians&mdash;one moving vertically, and a second, internal set moving horizontally.

Aristocrat Geonosians were also able to understand [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] fluently, unlike the lesser castes. It is unknown if they were all physically unable to speak Basic (much like [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]), or if they simply preferred their own language. The [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Karina the Great/Legends|Karina]] was known to be capable of speaking Basic. An off-world Geonosian, [[Tookra]], could also speak Basic.<ref name="Star Wars Adventures: Princess Leia and the Royal Ransom">''[[Star Wars Adventures: Princess Leia and the Royal Ransom]]''</ref>

The language was mostly spoken by Geonosians, but there were instances of offworlders understanding Geonosian without the immediate need of a translator; [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]],<ref name="rcr">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]],<ref name="g10">[[Star Wars Gamer 10|''Star Wars Gamer'' 10]]</ref> Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], and [[Ysanne Isard]] were notable examples. [[Marmio Mio]] also learned the language while on the planet.<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

Human vocal cords were apparently capable of reproducing the Geonosian sounds. Infected [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] were able to reproduce the sound fairly simply and authentically.<ref name="Brain Invaders">''[[Brain_Invaders]]''</ref>

{{Language-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] online chat, [[Matthew Wood]] said that the sound of the Geonosians was one of the weirdest he had ever recorded for a ''[[Star Wars]]'' movie. It consisted of a penguin mating call as well as fruit bats fighting over a banana.

In [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé]] are taken into the [[Petranaki arena|Geonosian execution arena]] to be killed, the Geonosians in the arena make noises that sound like [[Human/Legends|Human]] cheering instead of Geonosian-sounding noises, even though nearly everyone in the arena is a Geonosian with the exceptions of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].
